title: CalendarEvent/query ignores anchor and anchorOffset
description: RFC 8620 §5.5: anchor (Id|null) / anchorOffset (Int) select the page relative to the anchor; anchor absent from results MUST be anchorNotFound. crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/event.rs handle_calendar_event_query never parses anchor/anchorOffset, and CalendarBackend::query_calendar_events (backend.rs ~530) has no anchor parameters, so its default impl forwards query_objects(..., None, 0). Found while fixing JMAP-yt1w.22 (generic handle_query + all query_objects impls now honour anchor). Fix needs a breaking CalendarBackend::query_calendar_events signature change (add anchor, anchor_offset; parse with jmap_server::query_anchor_args; MemoryBackend/default impl forward to query_objects). Regression tests quote RFC 8620 §5.5.
